• FC Goa vs Sporting Club Delhi || Match Content || Highlights || Match 18 || 28-Oct-2026 || English ||
Drama at the death in Fatorda! Watch the big moments as FC Goa and Sporting Club Delhi drew 1-1 in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27, with the equaliser arriving in the 95th minute.
Juan Peña gave Delhi the lead early in the second half, finishing off Rodriguinho’s pass. Goa piled on the pressure with 20 shots. Álex Vallejo finally found the net from Francisco Feuillassier’s ball deep into stoppage time to rescue a point for the Gaurs.
